correctness.rationale: The completely additive H recurrence H(2)=1 and H(p)=1+H((p+1)/2) for odd primes decreases its argument, so is well-defined; multiplicativity of modified psi gives H(psi(m))=H(m) for odd m, H(psi(n))=H(n)-1 for even n, and lambda(m)=H(m) for odd m>1. Odd m has psi(m)>=m+1 and each subsequent even iterate n>2 satisfies psi(n)>=n/2, so any odd height-k m obeys m+1<=2^k. This rigorously confines *every* odd height <=23 to <2^23, so the sieve is exhaustive, not empirical. Independently implemented an 8,388,608-entry smallest-prime-factor/height recurrence, computed all class maxima k2..23, confirmed prime maxima through k22 and B23=8,193,151=127*64,513 > largest height23 prime 8,126,431. Every one of 97,728 larger possible odd competitors was screened and had height not 23. The source verify_defant_B23.py additionally checks selected defining-function trajectories; these and complete source recurrence were inspected. There is no claim about higher heights.
